title: Synthesis of a novel flame retardant containing phosphorus-nitrogen and its comparison for cotton fabric
treatment_method: Immerse 17 x 9 inch cotton fabric overnight at room temperature in CN formulation in 50% aqueous isopropanol; pad at 10 psi; dry at 100 C for 5 min; cure in air at 140 C for 5 min; cool in a desiccator and weigh, then test flammability immediately.
onset_definition: Author-reported onset of degradation; no percentage-loss definition, not T5/T10 or DTG maximum.
TG_locator: Table 4, p 967: CN rows at 5/10/16/21 wt% add-on; onset and char at 600 C in nitrogen, two observations per fabric.
LOI_locator: Table 3, p 967: same CN add-on rows, exact average LOI [standard deviation] and number of trials.
conditions_locator: Materials and Measurements and Fabric Treatment, p 964; thermal section p 967 explicitly specifies nitrogen.
pairing_evidence: Tables 2, 3 and 4 consistently identify mono-substituted CN with exact add-on levels. Prepared cotton twill and post-cure initial wash state match across assays. Only these four CN states are admitted; CN-1 comparison series is separately held.
source_location: Original author-uploaded final article pp 963-970; methods p 964 and Tables 2-4, pp 966-967.
limitations: Original author-uploaded final article reviewed as text; no PDF pixel review claimed. Table means retained rather than rounded abstract/prose summaries. Table 4 and thermal prose identify nitrogen only, despite methods mentioning air. Figure 4/5 captions inconsistently use CN-1/CN-2; those captions are not used for pairing or numeric extraction, which follows consistently labeled Tables 2-4 and surrounding prose. CN-1 comparison values overlap earlier pat.2008; these are held with source-specific LOI and add-on inconsistencies. Neat compounds, controls, unknown washed states and unreported air numbers excluded. TG mass and aliquot geometry not reported.
